title: create_session — spawn a session worker (two accepted call forms, NOT unified)
description: Domain: session/message (host). Sources: dispatch src/bin/ion.rs:7595; do_create_session src/bin/ion.rs:5125. Form split (recorded as-is, intentionally not 'fixed'): (1) RPC client form — fields nested under params; (2) flat stdin form — the whole command object is the params. Field naming: `project_path` OR `cwd` (3-level fallback project_path > cwd > host cwd, bin/ion.rs:5234), `session_id` optional (auto sess_<8hex>), `agent` default "build", plus optional model/provider/initial_prompt. Wire envelope (validated separately, not by this schema): worker replies {"id","type":"response","command","success":true,"data":<this payload>} (src/worker_rpc.rs output_response); host replies {"type":"response","id","success":true,"data":<this payload>,"session"?}. Errors use {"success":false,"error":string} with no data.
